chunks: Then the former will say to the latter: 'You have no privilege over us. So taste the punishment for what you had done.'
ai.seo_question: What do the early and late followers say to each other in the Hereafter?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the collapse of hierarchical claims among the disbelievers, where the early leaders (al-awwalun) admit to their later followers (al-akhirun) that their initial guidance offered no true spiritual advantage. It underscores the principle of individual accountability, as both groups face the consequences of their collective choices without intercession. This scene serves as a poignant reminder that worldly status or early adherence does not exempt one from divine justice.
